 Print Dhanteras is here, and with it the happy bustle that opens the five days of Diwali. This year, the festival falls on Friday, November 6, on the Trayodashi of Krishna Paksha in the month of Kartik. It’s the day families bring home something new, whether a coin, a utensil or just a broom, light the first diyas in the evening and welcome Goddess Lakshmi, Lord Kubera and Lord Dhanvantari, the god of health. Along with the shopping and the puja, there’s another lovely tradition: sending warm wishes to the people we love. If you’d like your message to feel personal rather than forwarded, here are 50 wishes, messages and quotes you can use as they are or tweak with a name and a memory. Happy Dhanteras 2026: Heartfelt wishes for everyone 
 These all-purpose greetings suit relatives, neighbours and friends alike. Wishing you and your family a very happy and prosperous Dhanteras. May Goddess Lakshmi’s blessings fill your home with joy.
 Shubh Dhanteras! May your home glow with diyas, your heart with gratitude and your life with abundance.
 May this Dhanteras bring you good health, steady wealth and plenty of reasons to smile.
 On this auspicious day, may Maa Lakshmi step into your home and stay for the whole year.
 May Lord Kubera open the doors of prosperity and Lord Dhanvantari bless you with good health. Happy Dhanteras!
 Wishing you a Dhanteras that is as bright as a thousand diyas and as warm as family.
 May every new thing you bring home today bring along happiness, luck and peace of mind.
 Happy Dhanteras! May your wallet stay full, your heart stay light and your home stay full of laughter.
 Let’s start this festival of lights by counting our blessings, the real wealth we already have. Shubh Dhanteras!
 May the golden glow of this auspicious day light up every corner of your life. Happy Dhanteras to you and yours.
 May Goddess Lakshmi bless your home with endless prosperity, good health and happiness, while Lord Dhanvantari brings peace and well-being to your family. Happy Dhanteras!
 Wishing you a Dhanteras filled with golden opportunities, beautiful beginnings and countless blessings. May every day bring you closer to your dreams and happiness.
 May the divine light of Dhanteras brighten your home, remove every worry and fill your life with wealth, wisdom, good health and positivity.
 On this auspicious occasion, may your hard work turn into success, your dreams turn into reality and your home always remain filled with love and laughter.
 May Goddess Lakshmi shower her blessings upon you and your loved ones, bringing financial stability, good fortune and happiness throughout the year. Shubh Dhanteras!
 Happy Dhanteras 2026: Messages for family 
 Dhanteras is a family festival at heart, so these are a little more personal. To my parents: your love is the greatest wealth I have. Wishing you good health and happiness this Dhanteras.
 To my spouse: you’re my fortune in every season. Happy Dhanteras, and may our home always be full of love.
 To my children: may you grow up with kind hearts, bright minds and every blessing. Happy Dhanteras, my darlings.
 To my brother and sister: may Lakshmi bless you with success, and may we keep celebrating together for years. Happy Dhanteras!
 To my grandparents: your blessings are my richest treasure. Wishing you a peaceful and joyful Dhanteras.
 To everyone at home: let’s light the first diya together this evening. Happy Dhanteras to my whole family.
 May our family stay together, healthy and happy, and may our table always have enough to share. Shubh Dhanteras!
 To my in-laws: thank you for making me feel at home. Wishing you prosperity and peace this Dhanteras.
 Happy Dhanteras 2026: Wishes for friends 
 Friends enjoy a little humour, so feel free to keep these light. Happy Dhanteras, my friend! May your savings grow and your shopping bags get heavier, within budget, of course.
 Wishing you more gold than you can count, more laughter than you can hold and more friends like me. Happy Dhanteras!
 May Lakshmi smile on you today and every day. Shubh Dhanteras to my favourite person.
 Here’s to good friends, good fortune and good food this festive season. Happy Dhanteras!
 You’ve been a blessing to me all year. May this Dhanteras return the favour. Wishing you joy and prosperity.
 May your dreams shine brighter than gold this Dhanteras. Keep shining, my friend.
 Dhanteras wishes to my partner in crime. May the coming year bring us bigger adventures and better luck.
 Warm wishes on Dhanteras. May the festival season fill your home with sweets, sparkle and people you love.
 Happy Dhanteras 2026: For colleagues, clients and neighbours 
 Keep these warm but polished, and send them early in the day. Wishing you and your family a prosperous Dhanteras. May the coming year bring success and good health.
 Thank you for your support this year. May Goddess Lakshmi bless you with growth and happiness. Happy Dhanteras!
 May this Dhanteras bring our team new energy, new opportunities and good fortune. Shubh Dhanteras!
 Warm Dhanteras greetings to you and your loved ones. May your business and your home flourish.
 To our neighbours, who feel like family: wishing you light, laughter and a safe, happy festival.
 May the festival of lights fill your home with peace and your work with success. Happy Dhanteras!
 Happy Dhanteras 2026: Wishes for health and wellbeing 
 Dhanteras is also Dhanvantari Jayanti, so good health deserves a mention. On Dhanvantari Jayanti, may you be blessed with good health. The greatest wealth is a healthy life.
 May Lord Dhanvantari keep you and your family strong, healthy and free from worry this year.
 Health is wealth, so here’s to a year of wellness, energy and good sleep. Happy Dhanteras!
 Wishing you a body that feels strong, a mind that feels calm and a heart that feels full. Shubh Dhanteras.
 May every member of your family stay healthy and happy, today and always. Happy Dhanteras.
 Eat well, rest well and love well. Wishing you the best of health this Dhanteras.
 Happy Dhanteras 2026: Short lines for WhatsApp and Instagram 
 Not everyone has time for a long message. These fit neatly over an image or a story. Shubh Dhanteras! Let the diyas shine.
 Wealth, health and happiness to you!
 Lakshmi Maa ki kripa sada bani rahe. Happy Dhanteras!
 New beginnings, bright diyas and blessed homes.
 Light a diya, count your blessings.
 Dhanteras vibes: gold, gratitude and good food.
 Happy Dhanteras 2026: Quotes and thoughts for the day 
 These reflections work well as captions beside a photo of your puja thali or a row of diyas. True wealth isn’t what’s in the locker, it’s who’s at the dinner table.
 A lit diya doesn’t lose its light by lighting another. Share your joy this Dhanteras.
 Prosperity begins with gratitude. Start the festival by being thankful for what you already have.
 Good health, a loving family and peace of mind are riches no market can sell.
 Buy something new today, but keep something old too: the values you grew up with.
 May we welcome Lakshmi not only into our homes, but into our habits: honesty, effort and kindness.
 Making your wishes feel personal
 A greeting means the most when it sounds like you. Add the person’s name, and mention something you share, like last year’s rangoli competition or a family recipe. Avoid sending the same forward to every group, and consider a voice note or a quick phone call for elders, which often means more than any graphic. Be mindful of friends who are mourning or who celebrate differently. And if you’re lighting diyas this evening, keep them away from curtains, decorations and anything flammable, and never leave them unattended.
